get.description: The caller's animals, active by default, or the archived ones.

post.description: Register an animal; whoever registers it becomes its first tutor.

delete.description: Delete for good: the animal, its records and its files.

get.description: Who has access to the animal, and with which role.

delete.description:
Remove someone (a tutor), or leave (anyone, their own access).

The last tutor of an animal can neither leave nor be removed: the animal
would be left with nobody responsible for it.

post.description: Archive with a reason and a date: off the home screen, reminders suspended.
Store photos or PDFs, to be referred to by records through their ids.

get.description: The card to show at the clinic's counter: one row per disease, last and next dose.

post.description: Send one or more photos of a card page; the reading runs in the background.
A single-use link, valid for 3 days, that grants a role on this animal.

get.description: The animal's history, every kind together, newest first.
Every reminder of one animal, open, closed and with no date.
The closed lists: diseases per species and the antiparasitic kinds.

post.description: Write one line as a record, as the tutor corrected it, with the whole photos attached.
Drop one line: nothing is written.
Read the same photos again, after a failure.

get.description: What the invite grants, shown before accepting (open to a caller with no account).

post.description: Accept: the access is created with the invite's role and end, and the invite is spent.
Register this phone's Expo push token for the caller (moves it if another had it).

get.description: The VAPID public key the browser subscribes with; empty when push is off.
